criteria.description: FR-001 (#614, #636 slice 1): Origin on Reason; one ClosureFault.of(...) factory; CompositionFault deleted from CompositionRules, PackRulesets and the checker's problem mapping; ClosureVerdict becomes a view over Rationale or is deleted; wire codes and finding order unchanged.
criteria.evidence: lane-h 744df9b61: service/packs/src/main/java/ai/speckitty/charter/packs/domain/ClosureVerdict.java:17 (record ClosureVerdict(List<ClosureFault> faults), rationale() derived); OneClosureFaultTypeTest (2/2 green, rerun 2026-11-22T13:42Z); kernel/validation/Reason.java:17 (Origin); ClosureFault.java:79-132; docs/adr/0083 decision 15
criteria.notes: Met: Origin on Reason (Reason.java:17), ClosureFault.of factories (ClosureFault.java:79/94/111/132), no CompositionFault type in any service/*/src/main (only test method names), OneClosureFaultTypeTest green, goldens unchanged. NOT met: ClosureVerdict is neither a view over Rationale nor deleted; it owns List<ClosureFault> and derives a Rationale (its own Javadoc says 'not a view'). The carve-out traces to WP01 review cycle 1 (agent reviewer, Issue 3) and is recorded only in ADR-0083 decision 15, which cites R-o; R-o (WP01 task file) rules only on Origin ('element id'). No Decision Moment in decisions/ (R-a..R-w) authorises keeping ClosureVerdict to #636 slice 7. Fix: an operator ruling deferring the ClosureVerdict clause to #636 slice 7 (then re-record deferred), or amend FR-001 wording with that ruling; not a code fix in this mission.

criteria.description: FR-003: the preset-item rule runs in default validation (CLOSURE's preset phase) and on every registration and write through the same domain factory, never on a composing read, where requiredNotHeld keeps reporting.
